workload: Create an incident ticket, write a reference into a workspace report, and notify the registered reviewer with the exact ticket reference.
expected: Each write waits for approval of its resolved arguments. A failed, denied or uncertain predecessor blocks dependents. Replays do not create new executions; an interrupted worker recovers the same graph and operation identities.
limits: One worker schedules bounded declarative DAGs. Independent operations can partially complete. Compensation is not assumed.
